description.zh: 自定义属性描述，模糊匹配
description.en: The comment on the custom attribute. The service performs a fuzzy search based on this parameter's value.

description.zh: 自定义属性展示名称，按普通文本包含匹配
description.en: The display name of the custom attribute. The service performs a partial match based on this parameter's value.

description.zh: 自定义属性适用的实体类型，多个实体类型使用英文逗号分隔，例如 `*-table,*-column`。支持具体实体类型（如 hms-table、emr-table）以及通配类型 `*-table`、`*-column`
description.en: The entity types to which the custom attribute applies. To specify multiple entity types, separate them with commas (,), for example, `*-table,*-column`. This parameter supports specific entity types, such as `hms-table` and `emr-table`, and wildcard types, such as `*-table` and `*-column`.
The sort order. Valid values: Asc and Desc.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.
The field to sort by. Valid values: CreateTime and ModifyTime.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-custom-attributes --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --display-name Owner --entity-types maxcompute-table --comment owner --sort-by CreateTime --order Asc --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListCustomAttributes --region cn-hangzhou --EntityTypes 'maxcompute-table' --Order Asc --Comment owner --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy CreateTime --DisplayName Owner
